final_topology.title: High Availability Branch Office
final_topology.description: A branch office network with emphasis on high availability and voice service continuity, connected to the central data center with a primary link and public phone network failover for voice services.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes a branch office connected to the central data center via a primary link, with a failover mechanism for voice services to the public phone network. It supports SIP-based voice traffic and includes centralized user authentication and network traffic logging.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' (n20) that manages various assets and their connections, indicating a detailed inventory of enterprise assets.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n21) that documents data flows between various nodes, indicating that data flows are documented.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for 'Sensitive Data Zone' (z8) and 'Non-Sensitive Data Zone' (z9), indicating that data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Server Firewall' (n22) that is connected to the 'SIP Server' (n4) and 'DNS Server' (n12), indicating that firewalls are implemented on servers.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n12) that is connected to the 'Primary Router' (n1), indicating that trusted DNS servers are configured on enterprise assets.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Server' (n11) that is connected to the 'Primary Link' (n9), indicating that MFA is required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filtering Service' (n23) that is connected to the 'DNS Server' (n12), indicating that DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'URL Filtering Service' (n24) that is connected to the 'Primary Router' (n1), indicating that network-based URL filters are enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones and nodes that are interconnected in a structured manner, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Management System' (n25) that manages various network components, indicating that network infrastructure is securely managed.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n5) and 'MFA Server' (n11) that are connected to various nodes, indicating centralized AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Primary Link' (n9) and 'Failover Link' (n10) that are connected to the 'Primary Router' (n1) and 'MFA Server' (n11), indicating that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Admin Workstation' (n16) in the 'Management Zone' (z4) that is connected to the 'Identity Server' (n5), indicating dedicated computing resources for administrative work.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IDS/IPS' (n14) that is connected to the 'Primary Router' (n1), indicating that a network intrusion detection solution is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' (n3) and 'Server Firewall' (n22) that are connected to various nodes, indicating traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Server' (n11) and '802.1X Controller' (n18) that are connected to the 'Primary Router' (n1), indicating access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Network Traffic Log Collector' (n26) that collects logs from various nodes, indicating that network traffic flow logs are collected.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IDS/IPS' (n14) that is connected to the 'Primary Router' (n1), indicating that a network intrusion prevention solution is deployed.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes an '802.1X Controller' (n18) that is connected to the 'Primary Router' (n1), indicating port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' (n17) that is connected to the 'Primary Router' (n1), indicating application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' (z6) that is peered with the 'Branch Office' (z1), indicating separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Host' (n19) and 'Penetration Testing Service' (n27) that are connected to various nodes, indicating periodic external penetration tests.
